content: Receiving SwComponentType owns a RunnableEntity- Group in the role regRequiresStability If a receiving SwComponentType owns a RunnableEntityGroup in the role regRequiresStability for one or sev- eral of its RunnableEntity s it is required that the values of implicitly communicated VariableDataPrototype s are kept stable over the execution of all RunnableEn- tity s belonging to the given RunnableEntityGroup .
